interventions.description: Install a protective railing or bollards along the curb to provide a physical buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Delineation
interventions.description: Use high-visibility paint or different materials to clearly define the pedestrian zone and highlight the presence of structural obstructions.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the walkway to provide a smooth, accessible path for all users.

interventions.title: Enhanced Lighting
interventions.description: Install bright, pedestrian-scale lighting to improve visibility and safety under the overpass.
